tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All other terms and conditions are as per tender document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Details of the Service Provider in the Format at Annexure A
Attested copy of the Certificate of registration in the Labour Department, Employees Provident Fund and ESI, GST certificate.
Anti-collusion and self -declaration certificate regarding not black listed by any firm/ Government agencies in the format set out in tender document.
Attested copy of the Income Tax return filed by the Service Provider for the last 3 years (financial years (2023-24 to 2025-26) in the Income Tax Department and the clearances

Certificate by Chartered Accountant for the Annual Turnover of Rs.17.00 lakhs relating to providing outsource personnel for the each of the last audited 3 financial years i.e., (2023-24 to 2025-26) with Balance sheet & P & L A/c.

The company/firm should have been in the business of providing manpower services for last financial years (2023-24 to 2025-26) Details of past performance on services of 50% similar nature executed by the Service Provider.
Certificate from the Banker that the bidder has liquid financial resources of not less than Rs.3,00,000/-(Three Lakhs only) as per the format in the Tender document
